item.title: Cardiovascular disease now leading cause of death among U.S. Hispanic adults
item.description: Cardiovascular disease has surpassed cancer as the leading cause of death among Hispanic adults in the U.S., driven by rising obesity and diabetes rates.

item.title: WHO validates Chile as first South American country to eliminate dog-transmitted rabies
item.description: Chile has become the first South American country to eliminate dog-transmitted rabies in humans, following over five decades of public health efforts.
